  leave_status_as_of_june_30.leave_status_as_of_june_30 AS leave_status_as_of_june_30
  ,num_employees

  ,avg_total_other_pay
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (
  USING nyc_pay_nyc_payroll_av
    HIERARCHIES (
       leave_status_as_of_june_30)
  )
WHERE
  leave_status_as_of_june_30.level_name = 'LEAVE_STATUS_AS_OF_JUNE_30'
ORDER BY 
  leave_status_as_of_june_30.leave_status_as_of_june_30

PROMPT: Select base salary, average years employed, average hourly rate for levels name id, fiscal year for Fiscal Year = '2019'
QUERY_TEXT:
SELECT
  agency.name_id AS name_id
  ,fiscal_year.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year
  ,avg_hourly_rate

  ,base_salary
  ,avg_years_employed
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (
  USING nyc_pay_nyc_payroll_av
    HIERARCHIES (
       agency
       ,fiscal_year)
  )
WHERE
  agency.level_name = 'NAME_ID'
  AND fiscal_year.level_name = 'FISCAL_YEAR'
  AND fiscal_year = '2019'
ORDER BY 
  agency.name_id
  ,fiscal_year.fiscal_year

PROMPT: Fetch average total other pay, regular gross paid across levels job title, leave status as of june 30 restricted to Job Title equal to 'SUPERVISOR OF ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS & MAINTENANCE'
QUERY_TEXT:
SELECT
  job_title.job_title AS job_title
  ,leave_status_as_of_june_30.leave_status_as_of_june_30 AS leave_status_as_of_june_30
  ,avg_total_other_pay
  ,regular_gross_paid
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (
  USING nyc_pay_nyc_payroll_av
    HIERARCHIES (
       job_title
       ,leave_status_as_of_june_30)
  )
WHERE
  job_title.level_name = 'JOB_TITLE'
  AND leave_status_as_of_june_30.level_name = 'LEAVE_STATUS_AS_OF_JUNE_30'
  AND job_title = 'SUPERVISOR OF ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS & MAINTENANCE'
ORDER BY 
  job_title.job_title
  ,leave_status_as_of_june_30.leave_status_as_of_june_30
